note: Machine where the game was installed before the harness existed, so there is no clean baseline. docs/16 section 'The uninstall-and-reinstall cycle' step 4 is what this recovers. The reinstall half is not done.

anticheat.driver_signer_note: Unlike AntiCheatExpert, every binary including the kernel driver carries the vendor's own CN, so signer clustering names the whole footprint on its own.

machine.note: In ordinary use during capture rather than freshly booted and idle, contrary to docs/16 section 'Reducing noise'. The machine also restarted at 13:16:58Z, between the vg-00-current and 10-vanguard-baseline captures; neither file recorded it, which is what motivated Snapshot::boot_session.

harness.note: Snapshots 10 to 12 predate Snapshot::boot_session and Snapshot::file_empty_directories, so the committed diff reports neither. The empty directories Vanguard left were established by hand and by snapshot 13, not by the diff.

uninstall.by: the maintainer, with the Riot Client closed
uninstall.reboot_note: Expected to be required and was not. With the client closed, vgk was not loaded, so nothing had to be deleted across a reboot and PendingFileRenameOperations was untouched.

removed.file_count_note: Eight stable files (seven signed, plus vgc.ico) totalling 207097451 bytes, and four log files totalling 10308 bytes that existed at that moment. A catalog entry needs the eight; the log count moves.

by_windows: HKCU/.../AppCompatFlags/Compatibility Assistant/Store, keyed by the path of the deleted uninstall.exe
by_the_observation_itself: HKCU/.../Explorer/TypedPaths/url1 = C:/Program Files/Riot Vanguard, written because somebody navigated there in Explorer during the cycle. It names the anti-cheat and survives the uninstall, and a name-matching residue scanner would report it as Vanguard's.

snapshots.10-vanguard-baseline: Vanguard installed, after the restart; vgk read as system in services and demand in registry, four minutes apart
snapshots.11-vanguard-baseline-2: Vanguard installed; the baseline the committed diff is taken against
snapshots.12-vanguard-uninstalled: after uninstall.exe; the after side of the committed diff
snapshots.13-vanguard-uninstalled-dirs: after uninstall.exe, first capture recording directories and boot session
snapshots.14-noise-floor: idle machine minutes after 13, to measure how much the new empty-directory list churns on its own
snapshots.15-reinstalled: pending - launch VALORANT so it reinstalls Vanguard
snapshots.storage: %LOCALAPPDATA%/WardSweep/observations/ - raw snapshots are NOT committed; they list every file under the profile
